scripts.dev: npm run build_proto && npm run build_santroller && npm run copy_santroller  && vite
scripts.build_proto: pbjs -w es6 --null-semantics -t static-module Santroller/proto/config.proto Santroller/proto/events.proto Santroller/proto/commands.proto -o src/components/SettingsContext/config.js && pbts -o src/components/SettingsContext/config.d.ts src/components/SettingsContext/config.js
scripts.copy_santroller: cp Santroller/build/santroller_pico_w.bin public/santroller_ota_pico_w.bin && cp Santroller/build/santroller_pico_w_fota.uf2 public/santroller_pico1.uf2 && cp Santroller/build/santroller_pico2_w.bin public/santroller_ota_pico2_w.bin && cp Santroller/build/santroller_pico2_w_fota.uf2 public/santroller_pico2.uf2 && cp Santroller/build/pico_w/commit.hash public
scripts.build: npm run build_proto && npm run build_santroller && npm run copy_santroller && tsc && vite build && cp dist/index.html dist/404.html
scripts.lint: npm run eslint && npm run stylelint
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run prettier && npm run lint && npm run build
